verdicts.quote: For now, swap running for low-impact cross-training like cycling or swimming, keep your easy runs on soft surfaces, and ice your shins after activity.
verdicts.why: Gives treatment and training changes for reported shin pain; no coach-contact line.
No weight target, weight-gain framing, or food-exercise tie-in.
Starts and ends with names, is specific, and has no guilt or bot language.
Session counts, sleep, and trend numbers match the member_week data.
